name: What should I do immediately if sewage is coming up through my drains?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if sewage is coming up through my drains?

acceptedAnswer.text: First, stop using all water sources in your home, including toilets, showers, and sinks. If safe, turn off your main water supply. Avoid contact with the sewage. Call a professional restoration company immediately to assess the situation and begin cleanup. Do not try to clean it yourself, as it requires specialized equipment and safety precautions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Immediately stop using all water sources, turn off your main water supply if safe, and avoid contact with the sewage. Call a professional restoration company right away.
